description: issue #844 negative case: without the `geometry` profile active, `grid` is not a visible primitive, so the arity gate must not fire — the callee is simply unknown and belongs to `ol-unknown-command` (issue #117), never double-reported as an arity error. Mirrors the `data`/`sound`/`interaction-events` gating discipline the other profile branches of checker-arity.ts already follow, and the reserved-word negative in geometry/check/reserved-word-not-gated-without-geometry.
